title: Immersions are separated; cancellation for separated morphisms
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. (a) If $f$ is an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] (in particular an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] or a closed immersion), then $f$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism]. (b) If $g\circ f$ is separated, then $f$ is separated.

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 01L7 (lemma-immersions-monomorphisms: an immersion is a monomorphism, in particular separated) and Lemma 01KV (lemma-compose-after-separated)

mathlib_searches.query: if the composition f ≫ g of morphisms of schemes is separated then f is separated
every immersion of schemes is a separated morphism; monomorphisms of schemes are separated
mathlib_searches.verdict: match for (a) via isSeparated_of_mono and the instance IsPreimmersion -> Mono
